Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a 'CDt/MS' approach which is essentially a FLAG-tagged affinity purification (AP-MS) to identify overexpressed proteins in a gain-of-function screen. While the biological results discuss acetylation of beta-catenin, the mass spectrometry part of the study described in the methods/PRIDE metadata is a standard AP-MS for protein identification and spectral counting, not a PTM-enrichment assay.

scope: Cells were lysed in cold RIPA buffer with protease and phosphatase inhibitors and immunoprecipitated for 1 hour at 4°C with FLAG M2 beads from Sigma Aldrich (St. Louis, MO).

primary_biological_variables.matched_definition: Increased expression of a gene, protein, mutant, construct, or transgene that defines the comparison.
evidence: we developed a genome-wide mass spectrometry-coupled gain-of-function genetic screen

the cytomegalovirus (CMV) promoter of the CDBF vector drives constitutive BFP (blue fluorescence protein) expression and by virtue of the splice donor (SD) sequence, an overexpressed FLAG-tagged fusion of the targeted gene.
Human A375 melanoma cells containing a β-catenin-driven GFP (green fluorescent protein) transcriptional reporter were transduced with CDBF lentivirus.
A BFP only population was also sorted as a negative control.
FACS was used to isolate BFP+/GFP+ (Wnt active) or BFP+/GFP- (Wnt inactive) A375 cells.
The FOXP1 transcription factor ranked as the top screen hit, as determined by spectral count abundance and the CompPASS WD-score across four biological replicate screens.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment described in the PRIDE metadata and Methods (CDt/MS protocol) is a gain-of-function screen using a lentiviral library to overexpress genes. The primary comparison is between cells that became Wnt-active (GFP+) and those that remained Wnt-inactive (GFP-), both expressing the BFP marker. While the paper discusses many other perturbations (siRNA, small molecules), only the CDt/MS screen is tied to the mass spectrometry data provided.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment used data-dependent acquisition (DDA) on an LTQ Orbitrap Velos and quantified proteins using spectral counting (a form of label-free quantification).

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: The study explicitly describes a FLAG epitope tag immunopurification (AP-MS) approach to identify overexpressed fusion proteins.
